justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Athletic performance gains well-documented; application to clinical rehab population is indirect.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: NSCA exam; bachelor's degree required; moderate cost ~$300-500 exam fee.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in sports performance, athletic training, and athlete rehabilitation; limited in general clinical settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No CSCS-specific billing in healthcare settings; used in athletic and corporate wellness where direct cash billing applies.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Valued in sports performance, collegiate strength staff, and athletic rehab settings; moderate clinical demand.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Athletes appreciate evidence-based strength programming; general rehab patients less influenced by credential.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Performance and fitness-adjacent services are core cash-pay territory.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Common credential — modest pricing power, more of a baseline than a premium.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Very common among PTs and trainers; weak differentiator.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Easy to scale a performance-PT hybrid model with multiple CSCS staff.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Strong consumer recognition in athletic and gym communities.
justifications.business.efficiency: Single exam, modest cost, fast to obtain — efficient.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Useful supporting credential for sports tracks, not a primary hiring criterion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: NSCA publishes substantial research on resistance training and performance.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Helpful for sports, exercise prescription, and performance content in DPT programs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Resistance training and performance literature is robust and growing.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally listed as 'preferred' for sports-track faculty roles.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Cheap and fast — high efficiency for the academic value it contributes.
